name: Cornellà de Llobregat (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the arms of Cornellà de Llobregat (a lozenge with a black raven's head on the four bars, beneath a mural crown).
history: Municipal flag of Cornellà de Llobregat; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cornellà de Llobregat arms — lozenge with a raven's head on the four bars, mural crown
